notes.title: Update 1.2 released!
notes.content:
It has been a while but here is Update 1.2, which brings much wanted new features and tons of improvements:

HUD speed-o-meter
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32452015/d7c48edff7a1ac51df7a6801f080ce865c687c32.png

More extreme!
Improvements in engine technology now allow speeds of up to 2000kmph, double the previous amount!
And you can now grow your train to 250 wagons (against 50 previously).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32452015/9c0d9e4699ae238622bbf8340b8e24a95f1a0ac6.jpg

Booster and brake segments
Make use of high energy booster rail segments to catapult your train forward! But avoid the brake rail segments or you will grind to a halt...

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32452015/1e55b7db9ae913d3cf405d37383e1dc48b86cc12.png

4K and wide screen support
Get totally immersed with 4K and wide screen support.

Optimizations
The render engine has undergone optimizations, resulting in a draw distance that is now twice what it was previously.

Quality of life improvements & Bug fixes
A lot of effort has been spent on making the UI more accessible by adding guidance and tooltips.
Sound design has been revamped and the road generation algorithm has been improved.
Gameplay has been rebalanced.
Many bugs have been squashed, a big thanks to the players for reporting!

All changes
Here's a full list of all the changes:

 new: 4K and wide-screen support
 new: more vegetation & building variation
 new: HUD speed-o-meter
 new: camera rotation is now stored when changing camera mode
 new: display mode setting
 new: settlement screen now emphasizes your ownership of the settlement
 new: pod shape loc style
 new: booster and brake rail segments
 new: UI tool tips
 new: map screen: settlement details now also shows settlement production
 new: optimized rendering resulting in twice the view depth
 new: (build mode) guidance
 fixed: button click was not always registered
 fixed: graphics reinitialization issue after changing settings
 fixed: several road intersection issues
 fixed: pressing ESC while in the keymapping dialog caused UI corruption
 fixed: borderless windowed mode 
 fixed: unlimited cash bug (buy wagon->sell wagon->buy wagon etc.)
 fixed: issue that caused Predator achievement to be unobtainable
 fixed: issue with skydome projection causing the stars to rotate faster than the camera
 fixed: issue with drag not working if controlling locs were switched
 fixed: depth fog distance did not depend on render distance
 fixed: camera orientation was not preserved when toggling dialogs
 fixed: roads were not displayed on the map near isolated factories
 fixed: when loading a lost game the payer could still be appointed the victor
 fixed: flare rendering issue on trains on AMD GPUs
 fixed: multi-turret HUD icon visibility issue
 fixed: road connection issue with high spirals
 fixed: flickering mouse cursor issue in map screen on AMD graphcis cards
 changed: max train speed set to 2000kmph (previously: 1000kmph)
 changed: max wagon count increased to 250
 changed: smoothened lane change camera rotation animation
 changed: removed multiplayer part
 changed: doubled shadow map resolution
 changed: various improvements to gameplay balance
 changed: minor water improvements
 changed: increased screen transition speed
 changed: music minimal volume set to 15%
 changed: improved particle explosions
 changed: disabled shadows on building sides to prevent shadow artifacts
 changed: in windowed mode a resolution change is now applied immediately
 changed: wagon cost now increases linearly with train length
 changed: no online connection to Steam is needed anymore to run the game
 changed: tooltips now appear instantly
 changed: UI skinning
 changed: terrain now fades in from the distance instead of building-up
 changed: replaced outlined font rendering with boxed font rendering for speed reasons
 changed: engine sounds are now muted when the game is paused
 changed: traffic now moves generally faster
 changed: music is now played less frequently and its volume is not coupled to the train speed anymore
 changed: normalized loudness of all sound fx
 changed: ambient sound fx are now muted while the train is driving
 changed: map screen: global market now indicates demand and price instead of demand and supply
 changed: decreased road segment construction cost by 80%
 changed: decreased traffic crash reputation penalty by 60%
 changed: to upgrade, settlements don't require goods they produce themselves anymore
 changed: to obtain the Top Speed achievement one must go at least 1900kmph
 changed: improved shadow quality
 changed: boost speed can now exceed max train speed, i.e. boosting
 changed: occurence of high spirals
 removed: height fog


Hope you like this update! Happy driving,
nkm

notes.title: Update v1.1 is out now!
notes.content:
Hi Hypertrainers,

This update focusses mainly on bug fixes and tweaks. More to come soon! Thanks again everybody for your feedback and support for the game!


NEW FEATURES

Toy Train Style
As requested by one of the game's biggest fans: Alex Chosen!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32452015/c80add9aa22cced2923877d206357e76b0dcdd91.png

Sonic Boom
Another idea by Alex (thanks!). A sonic boom can now be heard when a train goes through the sound barrier, at 1234kmph. 

Windowed Mode
You can now run the game in windowed mode using the -windowed command line argument. Note that this feature is experimental. The game might not adapt well to non-16:9 window aspect ratios.



CHANGES


    Added more tooltips to help new players.
    Various localization changes.
    Various UI tweaks.




FIXES


    Fixed a bug that caused the train to point in the opposite direction when respawning.
    Fixed a multiplayer bug that caused the game to crash when someone completed a mission.
    Fixed a couple of minor UI bugs.



nkm

notes.title: Hypertrain v1.0 released! Departing for Early Access on February 28th!
notes.content:
After almost one year of implementing community-fed feedback, fixing bugs and polishing with bleeding fingers, Hypertrain is now ready to exit Early Access! All the important systems are working (e.g. multiplayer) and the pillar gameplay features have been added.

Thanks to everyone who helped me achieve this! I develop this game in my spare time while having a full day job, which can be demanding energy-wise sometimes. But your enthousiasm (next to my own ːsteamhappyː) keeps me motivated!

v1.0 will not be the end of the updates for sure. I've got much more stuff on my wish list. Stay tuned.

Now follows the list of changes brought by v1.0:

MAJOR NEW FEATURES

Marauder Boss
The head of the Marauder clan hides in his tower of doom. You need to be pretty beefed up to have a chance of taking him out. If you manage though, you'll be rewarded with good(ies).

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32452015/33e264c51a45c407f931ae6f0cf182b4c44dfd56.png

New World Settings
You can now adjust the world size. The default size is 128x128km but you can now go up to 1024x1024 if you're masochistic.

Victory length can now also be adjusted, from 50 to 100 wagons.


MINOR NEW FEATURES


    Build Mode actions are now mapped onto the num pad keys.
    You can now bring up a command console by pressing F5. The following commands are currently available: hidehud to hide the game HUD and showhud to unhide it.


CHANGES


    Added variety in traffic speed.
    Improved train explosion effect.
    Decreased the amount of loops in loopings.
    Decreased the chance of roads with ceilings.
    Increased the amount of coins dropped by killed commuter/marauder trains.
    Speed bonus is now indicated by a percentage instead of a factor.
    Commuters will now move more goods per trips.
    Gold items can now contain cards as well (small chance).
    Decreased the cost of the Luxury Passenger Wagon by 50%.
    Increased the pay-out of VIP passenger missions by 100%.
    Construction wagon build mode speed increase lowered from 100kmph to 50kmph.


FIXES


    Fixed auto-aiming bug.
    Hall of Fame did not show build technologies.
    Fixed buildings and trees intersecting the road.
    Fixed some road generation bugs.
    Fixed coorp trains now showing up in purple when communicating.
    Fixed an issue where a multiplier card was not applied for repair, assassination or construction missions.


nkm

P.S. the official full release date is February 28th.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32452015/6dd671f3d4bf3f03862679d413a0c55cade1a4a1.png

notes.title: Update v0.10 released!
notes.content:
Get ready for the first update of 2019!

This update focuses on Production Facilities, Multiplier Cards, a multiplayer matchmaking server and many quality of life improvements.

MAJOR NEW FEATURES

Production Facilities
Production Facilities are special settlements that do not appear on the map. If you manage to find and hook up a Production Facility you are rewarded with one of three types of Multiplier Cards (see below).

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32452015/eba895d9c6b09579adcfa46580746372f52fc443.png

Multiplier Cards
These collectible wildcards come in three flavours: x3, x5 and x10 (rare). When you accept a mission you can use a Multiplier Card to boost the mission pay-out by respectively 3 times, 5 times and 10 times. A card is consumed on use.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32452015/f4f5d770fa68c88544b09f9f47de6b906dcd6a22.png

Multiplayer Matchmaking Server
Multiplayer servers are now automatically registered at a central matchmaking server. This way players can now conveniently select a server from a list in the game. I've also set up a dedicated game server here for people to play on.

NS 450
As requested by a user. This is a classic 50s locomotive which once served here in The Netherlands.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32452015/4a0c42494b185f5e250ab7a9ac6bc06a45deaa88.png

OTHER NEW FEATURES


    Pressing the S key (by default) will now gradually decelerate the train.
    The game is now automatically paused when starting from a save game.
    You can now use your own music. See the Steam Guides section for more info on this.


CHANGES


    Improved world generation speed by 50%.
    The game now notifies you more explicitly on events like passenger claims, lost cargo etc.
    Braking in Build Mode does not result in a full stop anymore.
    If you sell a wagon it will now be added to the settlement's stock.
    Building a left-most or right-most lane using build width 3 will now result in two more lanes on your left or right, i.e. the game will always build 3 lanes.
    You can now toggle between a 5 and 15 degrees bend angle which makes building smoother curves possible.
    When you upgrade a settlement its stock is now replenished to such amount that trading goods is immediately possible.
    You cannot build road segments next to signs and stations anymore.


BUG FIXES


    Fixed a bug where loading a game with a victor could cause another victor to be announced.
    Fixed checker pattern road bug.
    Fixed a bug that caused new player points to be rewarded everytime the same loaded game was won.
    Fixed a bug where the wagon icon and description were not updated after a wagon was upgraded.
    Picking up energy items when going >1000 kmph will not slow down the train anymore.
    Trains  stats will now be properly updated when a wagon is sold.
    Fixed a bug that caused toll payments to be deducted at different rates depending on the number of settlement connections in the world.
    FIxed a bug that made you pay toll on your own roads.
    Fixed a bug that caused the game to crash when entering the Hall of Fame screen.


Thanks again everyone for your feedback!
nkm

notes.title: Update v0.9 is out!
notes.content:
It's the season to release another Hypertrain update!

This update brings some exciting new features as well as many bug fixes and tweaks. Thanks again for all your feedback!


MAJOR NEW FEATURES

Construction Missions
Settlements will now give missions for constructing roads to (nearby) unconnected settlements. The train that builds the shortest road will be given a big sack of gold and - as the owner of the road - is entitled to all the toll payments given by Corp trains using the road.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32452015/4781301d726e7e8284be00014c2f78cc958e0a46.png



Construction Tech Tree Path
Construction is now one of the main strategies to win the game. This is reflected by the tech tree which now contains a path tailored to construction.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32452015/5eb30c63db499b72b95c73d3897c0ce3b6faed61.png


Construction Wagon
The Construction Wagon lets you build three lanes at once. Futhermore, every additional Construction Wagon adds 100kmph to the maximum allowed train speed while building (to a maximum of 500kmph).

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32452015/47954781d9951d7c9f71f767d9f8e4fb94480875.png


Repair Missions
Settlements will now ask you to fix holes in existing Corp-created roads. Don't crash against holes, just fix them! :)

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32452015/716a973bc0c20a89c6975f74bc44740dd17fca64.png



OTHER NEW FEATURES


World Settings: there is now a "none" option for connections.
Additional ambient sound effects.



CHANGES


Construction cost: building a road segment now costs coins.
Significantly lowered the chance of road obstacles in corkscrews and such.
Lowered the cost of the Radar Wagon.
Terrain generation while building is now significantly faster.




FIXES


    Fixed a bug that caused the game speed to increase when looking up or down.
    Fixed "rubber banding" issues in multiplayer mode.
    Fixed issue where the game would suddenly put your train in another lane.
Fixed issue in the Wagon Screen where wagons could disappear after a 
wagon drag-and-drop action.
 .. and many more.


Please note that this version of the game is not backwards compatible with previous save games. Too much has changed within the game to make this viable. After v1.0 save compatibility will be guaranteed with every update.

Also note that not all localisation has been updated. At the moment only NL is completely up to date.

Finally, after v0.9 comes v0.10. Don't expect v1.0 too soon :)

Happy holidays!
nkm

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32452015/48503e1f145ceb1bf798905104a51e43455e9a4a.png

notes.title: Update v0.8 out now!
notes.content:
Another month, another update! This update focuses on multiplayer coop play through the addition of factions.

MAJOR NEW FEATURES

Factions
A faction allows human players to work together under a single banner. Faction members share settlement ownership bonuses. Each faction has a tax fund which is used to distribute the faction's total wealth evenly across its members. A faction wins the game if the average of the lengths of all its members surpasses 50.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32452015/790010df1cd5fdfe603d62450fd36fa17ad86d02.png

Toll Revenues
Toll is now paid to the creator of the road segment. Toll revenues are paid out at the end of the day.

Shop Stock
Settlement shops now have a limited supply of wagons. 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32452015/9c3130c3f06892fa86079f49adb11c8eac9dedc6.png

Control Mapping
Controls can now be mapped to custom keys!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32452015/5bc93d13671d3e5fbc7bae8f5f3c93775b83826e.png

OTHER NEW FEATURES


Winding road segments.
New types of road overhangs.
Neon signs on stations and some buildings.
Purple gold items. Can be found in Marauder Nests. Rare but valuable.
Navigation Wagon. Provides HUD aids for navigation. Previously these aids (i.e. the compass and mission target indicators) were available by default.


CHANGES


Doubled the chunk size, which means the render distance is now doubled without any performance loss.
Improved cloud variety.
Starting settlements are now 50% larger.
Lots of minor UI changes.


FIXES


Fixed movement glitch when switching locomotives.
Fixed movement glitch when changing lanes to freshly built road segments.
Fixed movement glitch of battle trains.
Fixed issue where off-road trials were cut off by the main road.




We've also done extensive updating of the Hypertrain wiki. Be sure to check it out here.

Known issue: not all language files have been updated yet.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32452015/451cc74947781228842552f2331d60c3f235e0e2.png

notes.title: Update v0.7 released!
notes.content:
Hi players,

Time for another update!

Major New Features

Corp Battletrains
These trains pack a real punch. They protect important Corp properties and attack everyone with a reputation (REP) lower than 25%. Respect The Corp!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32452015/4dd9a15e011264e170f3f895c0cc511c6bbd4954.png

Covered Roads
Some of the roads you'll encounter now have ceilings. These are excellent hiding spots.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32452015/6aa51930c48c86d23812344380cc01a95a288608.png

16km Render Distance
If your system can handle it.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32452015/39d05ff9d8585206fcb0aa251de8be49c5e8b80b.png

Battery Wagon
With the all new Battery Wagon you will never run out of energy anymore.

Plasma Shield
You can now upgrade a Shield Wagon to a Plasma Shield Wagon which protects 3 times better than the normal Shield Wagon.

Official Steam Controller Profile
The controls have been changed a bit to accomodate controller usage. The offical Steam Controller Profile can be found here: steam://controllerconfig/833030/1526164452


Changes


    Added another unlockable locomotive style based on the Corp battletrain.
    Added Turret Wagon nozzle flash effect.
    Various cosmetic UI changes.
    Gold items now spawn in the center of dead trains.
    The build sound that plays while auto-building will now gently fade out when its frequency is increased.



Fixes


    Fixed bug that caused spawning of traffic trains without cargo wagons.
    Fixed bug in mission generator which caused missions to be generated with invalid quantities.
    Player-constructed roads are now visible in the Map Screen.
    Fixed bug that caused Marauders to shoot in the wrong direction.
    Energy items will now spawn on roads with only one lane.



Once again thanks for playing! 

nkm


https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32452015/27a8f1c74f7cd934dd7b975c1be3c02c8d9c7322.png

A good you're still here! FYI the game will be discounted by -40% from the 8th until the 15th of October!

notes.title: Update v0.6 out now!
notes.content:
Hi Hypertrainers!

Another big update is out! v0.6 adds the following:

New Features


     Wagon Upgrades: you can now upgrade a Turret Wagon to a Double Barrel Turret Wagon for double the fire power. Passenger Wagons can be upgraded to Luxury Passenger Wagons to allow for the transportation of VIP passengers. Cargo Wagons can be upgraded to Oil Wagons to be able to transport the new Oil good.

     VIP passengers: these people pay well and boost your passenger trust (TRUST) but be sure to give them a smooth ride or their claims will hurt you. Require Luxury Passenger Wagons.

     Desert biome, Oil good and Oil Cargo Wagons: the new Oil good is now a requirement for upgrading your cities to metropoles. The new Oil Cargo Wagon upgrade is required to move Oil around. But beware: oil is highly explosive! An exploding Oil Wagon might cause a chain reaction of exploding wagons which can be disastrous for your train!

     Locomotive skins and customizable horn sound fx's: unlock skins and horn sound fx while you level up.

     Hints overview: in the game's Help screen.

     French translation: special thanks to Théo "BLU REMOTE" Parizot. ːsteamhappyː



https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32452015/351f232fc59d48d24912ea1eb2db30d0d5142695.png


Changes



 Default passenger claims lowered to 75% of the mission fee (was 200%).
 Changed the appearance of Marauders.
 Diamond now only spawns in mountainous biomes.
 In case of missing translatation the game now falls back to english.
 Damage now negatively affects AI locomotive acceleration.
 Marauders will now favor attacking Passenger Wagons instead of Locomotives.
 Gold items will now disappear after a while.
 Gold items cannot be destroyed anymore with bullets.
 If a settlement is upgraded it will now instantly produce 5 times (as if 5 days ended).
 Corp hypertrains now drop more gold when killed.
 New default seed.




Fixes



 Fixed issue that caused a vertical Marauder Nest's to be broken at its base.
 Fixed roads going through terrain in mountainous areas.
 Fixed settlements spawning under sea level.
 Fixed road coloring issues.
 Fixed issue that caused lens flares to pierce through geometry.
 ... many small bugs.



Thanks for playing! More to come soon...

nkm


https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32452015/b8a4730f7458eb895e85dd84e9104fd787ab6cc6.png

notes.title: Update v0.5 released!
notes.content:
After many weeks of work I'm happy to release the multiplayer update of Hypertrain! This is a big update touching most of the functionality of the game. Thanks for all your support so far! 

Note that the game is still very much in Early Access, so expect bugs.

New Features



 Multiplayer ːsteamhappyː. Play against others (PvP) and the Corp (PvE) in a shared Hypertrain world! Information on how to set up your own dedicated multi-player server can be found in the Steam guides section.

 Autobuild. Just drive and rail segments will be added automatically. Works at speeds up to 250kmph.

 Shield wagon. Protects adjacent wagons (or locomotives) against bullets.

 Mission target HUD indicators. These help with finding the right directions.

 AI level setting. A lower AI level means a longer game. 

 Additional music from Maxvic.

 Stair-shaped city buildings.

 Corp passenger-only trains. Treat them with respect.

 Language support for Czech (CS) and Spanish (ES). 





Changes



 Improved Mission Payout screen layout.
 If a cargo wagon breaks down you will now lose the cargo.
 If a passenger wagon is hit then all passengers will now lose trust in you and will claim you. Use shield wagons to protect your passengers!
 The effectiveness of booster and repair wagons will now depend on their health.
 Player XP points are now also granted for lost games.
 Marauders and Corp trains are now brightly lit at night. Removed the less effective blinking green lights.
 Changed the appearance of Marauder wagons.
 Colliding does not always result in a crash now.
 Game now starts with a random piece of music.
 Many small gameplay tweaks.




Fixes



 Issue that caused some special characters (like Ä, Ö Ü) not to display.
 Pressing ESC in some windows could freeze the game.
 Some ring road exits were too steep, causing road blocks.
 At high speeds the train model could jitter.
 .. many other minor bugs.





Stay tuned for more updates!

nkm

notes.title: Next update
notes.content:
Hi guys,

Here's an update on what I'm currently doing.

Currently I'm slowly but steadily working on the multi-player mode of Hypertrain. As expected, this is a lot of (complex) work which also touches large parts of the single player code of the game. When I've got something working I will probably release it in a multi-player Steam branch first before merging it with the main branch.

The multiplayer setup will be client-server, in which anyone can run a dedicated server and up to 64 (hopefully, also depending on the power of the server) players can join in. It will be both PvP and PvE. That's the goal at least.

If in the meantime game breaking bugs emerge in the current version of the game then I'll definitely release patches. Bug fixing has the highest priority as always.

@31/07: we just had the second multiplayer test and it went very well! I'll be on vacation for the rest of the month but in September I'm planning to release the multiplayer mode and continue with the rest of the gameplay features. See you soon!

Cheers,
nkm

notes.title: Game updated! v0.4.5
notes.content:
Hi guys,

As promised, another update. A lot of time went into Multi-language support. Not a very sexy feature I know :) But important regardless for the future of Hypertrain. And when german is added soon Steam allows me to call the game Hochgeschwindigkeitszug ːsteamhappyː

Unfortunately Steam Achievements take a bit longer than expected. Hopefully they will be done for the next update (v0.4.6).


New Features


    Wagons Screen: here you can reorder your wagons and optionally sell them.

    Multi-language support. The first supported language is dutch! More to come.

    Mouse Invert Y setting.

    VSync setting.


Changes


    Added 1680x1050 screen resolution.

    Visiting a station will not reset the turret cool down time anymore.

    A long AI player will not risk his train by attacking you.

    A successful mission now yields +10% reputation.

    Faster bullets.

    Changed the boosting sound.

    You need to be driving less than 100kmph to be able to enter Build Mode now.



Fixes

    Pressing 'v' crashed the game.

    Keys didn't work when CAPS LOCK was on.

    Some world seeds caused the game to crash.

    Sometimes the game screen remained black after a load.

    A blue/purple power item showed a hp bar when it was hit by a bullet.

    Sometimes the tutorial got stuck in a step.

    It was possible to get multiple Hall of Fame entries by finishing the same save game multiple times.


And some optimzations all around.

Thanks for your feedback. Happy playing!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32452015/4c2617a91fc063cf07d53857f430d2857a7a6347.png

notes.title: Update v0.4.4 released!
notes.content:
Wow! That was quite some week. Thanks everybody for your support! We're super motivated to make Hypertrain as good as it can be. 

Here's the first official update which includes many suggestions and bug fixes as reported by you guys. Thanks for that! 

Important: the Steam Overlay caused problems for some people. With this update the issues should be resolved. So you can safely turn on the Steam Overlay again. :)

New Features


New terrain features: rivers and windmills.

More variation in city styles and a new style.

Zen mode. Totally relaxed driving: no traffic, no other hypertrains, no marauders, no obstacles.

Screen resolution setting.

Fog banks.

Info bits are now shown in the loading screen.


Changes


Cleaned up the new game dialog.

Map Screen icons won't overlap anymore.

Distant geometry now gently fades in.

Settlements now start with random population sizes.

Made compass look more like an actual compass.

Added controls info in the Map Screen.

Settlement details in Map Screen now show discovery bonus amounts.

Changed the looks of coin items.

Brake sound will not play anymore when braking at a speed below 100kmph.

Decreased AI train firing distance and accuracy.


Fixes


Steam overlay caused rendering artifacts.

Jet engines upgrade was not activate until a new wagon was added.

Screen sometimes turned black when travelling at very high speeds.

Empty save file names crashed the game.

Pressing ESC in the save dialog caused weird GUI issues.

Map direction icon and compass icon were not in sync.

Trains were sometimes respawned backwards.

It was possible to delete a segment while driving forward.

notes.content:
DISCOUNT

It's almost time for departure! Be sure to grab the game during its first week while it is priced at a 25% discount.

NEXT UPDATE

In the meantime we're already working on the next update, which includes (amongst others):

    rivers.
    more variaton in settlement styles and a new exotic settlement style.
    improved night visuals.
    fog banks.
    various UI improvements.


Happy driving!
